name: quick-fix
title: 빠른 수정
use: Small fix whose cause is already known: fix, gate, then restart and one screen shot. Cause unknown: sidereus-bugfix.
rules:
Repo: this repository (the folder holding AGENTS.md). AGENTS.md rules override this prompt.
NEVER commit/stash/checkout/reset/add, NEVER run screen_check --update. The orchestrator commits.
One fix per run: anything else you find goes in findings, not in the fix.

stages.title: 수정
stages.task: Apply the minimal fix at the known cause and add or update a regression test. Report changed files; anything outside the fix goes in findings.

stages.title: 확인
stages.task: No edits. Restart the viewer (launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/io.sidereus.viewer), wait until /api/state answers 200, take one screenshot of the fixed spot at 1100 px width, then close the browser. ⚠Never press a real send/confirm button.
